title: Futures cash settlement with correlated reinvestment
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. Dates are0,1,2. Cash growth0-to1 is1. At1 one of two states is revealed; both final commodity spot and cash growth1-to2 then become deterministic. State probabilities are under the money-market pricing measure. A forward settles only at2. A futures contract marks to market at1 and2; its time1 quote equals the now-known final spot, so the last mark is zero. All variation cash is reinvested or borrowed at the state rate. Return fair forward strike, initial futures quote, futures-minus-forward basis, and expected time2 wealth from one long zero-cost futures contract.

outputs.name: expected_terminal_wealth
outputs.description: Expected reinvested variation cash for one unit.

instructions: Solve the synthetic quantitative-finance question using its supplied inputs and conventions. A calculator or local code is allowed. External market data is unnecessary. Return JSON with question_id and answers, where answers maps every output name to its typed value. Numeric arrays must follow the specified order. Optional rationale belongs at the top level and is not graded. Unknown answer keys are reported but do not erase credit for declared outputs.
